name: DocuSign CLM
description: DocuSign CLM is an enterprise contract lifecycle management platform for agreements, document repositories, generation, negotiation, workflows, tasks, attributes, parties, approvals, and contract operations.
agentUseSummary: Connect an approved CLM OAuth integration, then let selected agents read one exact minimized folder from an account-issued CLM API host. Relay does not expose contracts, documents, content, attributes, tasks, workflows, searches, parties, users, locks, versions, downloads, uploads, or mutations.

capabilities.label: Read folder metadata
capabilities.description: Use one pinned GET for exact, minimized CLM folder metadata.

allowed.label: Read CLM folder metadata
allowed.description: Read one exact minimized folder from the account-issued CLM Object API host.

blocked.label: Change DocuSign CLM
blocked.description: Contracts, documents, attributes, tasks, workflows, folders, parties, users, locks, versions, uploads, downloads, and every mutation remain blocked.

blocked.label: Read contract data
blocked.description: Document content and metadata, attributes, parties, users, tasks, workflow history, search results, audit details, download links, previews, and OCR are blocked.

blocked.label: Call arbitrary CLM APIs
blocked.description: Unvalidated hosts, legacy SpringCM endpoints, Content and Task APIs, arbitrary routes, methods, queries, bodies, and bulk reads are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: One exact minimized folder read runs directly. Documents, attributes, parties, users, tasks, workflows, searches, arbitrary APIs, and every mutation remain blocked.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts one exact folder-metadata read through the encrypted CLM OAuth connection.
Railway mounts one exact folder-metadata read through the encrypted CLM OAuth connection.

providerSetup.blocker: No CLM-enabled developer or production account, Relay-owned integration key, production client secret, approved go-live, customer authorization, account-specific API origin, account ID, representative folder, or safe fixture is available in this workspace.
providerSetup.nextAction: Provision a CLM developer account, register the OAuth integration and callback, complete required development validation and manual CLM go-live, configure Railway production credentials, then verify OAuth, the exact folder read on the account-issued host, assignment, refresh, disconnect, provider revocation, and post-disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: DocuSign documents the CLM Object API folder Get operation used as Relay's single fixed read.
DocuSign documents CLM developer-account provisioning, OAuth requirements, production account requirements, development calls, and manual CLM go-live review.
DocuSign documents account-specific Azure CLM hosts plus separate Object and Content APIs and sensitive upload, download, OCR, preview, lock, and version operations Relay excludes.
DocuSign's CLM go-live documentation supports treating production setup and validation as an external provisioning gate.
